Module 4 GradCafe Analysis

This application collects GradCafe applicant records, stores them in PostgreSQL, and displays analysis through a Flask web interface.

Module 4 adds automated verification of the web page, interactive buttons, analysis formatting, database operations, and integration flows.

Documentation

The documentation covers developer setup, the web/ETL/database architecture, an automatically generated API reference, and the testing workflow.
